alias: Dining Room - Desk - Night Time Notifies If Plug is on
description: At 21:00 every day, warns about each computer desk that has been left switched on (owner, 2026-11-09): a desk counts only if its plug is on and it is drawing 30 W or less, since a desk drawing more than 30 W is in use and not forgotten. The phone notification and the spoken message name the desks left on, and nothing is sent when there are none. Desks: the dining room desk (switch.dining_room_desk_plug, sensor.dining_room_desk_plug_power) and the games room desk (switch.games_room_desk_plug, sensor.games_room_desk_plug_power). Created in the HA editor, now kept in tools/ha/automations in the HomeAssistant repo.

variables.desks_left_on: {% set desks = [('dining room desk', 'switch.dining_room_desk_plug', 'sensor.dining_room_desk_plug_power'), ('games room desk', 'switch.games_room_desk_plug', 'sensor.games_room_desk_plug_power')] %}{% set found = namespace(names=[]) %}{% for name, plug, power in desks %}{% if is_state(plug, 'on') and states(power) | float(0) <= 30 %}{% set found.names = found.names + [name] %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ found.names }}

data.title: {{ 'Desk' if desks_left_on | length == 1 else 'Desks' }} left on?
data.message: The {{ desks_left_on | join(' and ') }} might still be switched on
Hey, it's 9PM and the {{ desks_left_on | join(' and ') }} {{ 'is' if desks_left_on | length == 1 else 'are' }} still switched on.
